messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The configuration of 13 points in the unit square maximizing the minimum triangle area is the regular 3x3 grid of points in {1/4, 1/2, 3/4}^2, augmented by the four corners of the square, achieving a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/16. This bound is optimal because the unit square can be partitioned into 16 congruent sub-squares of side 1/4; by pigeonhole, any 13-point configuration must place three points into some sub-square, yielding a triangle of area at most 1/16, and the grid-corner construction realizes this bound with every minimal-area triangle having its three vertices in a single sub-square."}
